The tenant pays electricity directly to the electricity company as per the bill.
The tenant may change the main door lock at his own cost and shall hand over all keys on vacating.
Renewal is by mutual agreement in writing, with the rent to rise by 5% a year.
The owner may visit for repairs after agreeing a time with the tenant at least a day before.
